contact.title: پشتیبانی
contact.text: جهت ثبت تبلیغات و استعلام قیمت بنر به آیدی زیر در تلگرام پیام دهید:

downloads.notes: v12 — stable ping progress, fresh search generations, deterministic order
changelog: Ping progress advances as soon as workers start
Native probes are bounded so repeated timeouts cannot accumulate without limit
START SEARCH replaces the previous Free list instead of appending to it
Rows keep a stable order during a sweep and after reopening the screen
Free-list cleanup preserves My Configs measurements

downloads.notes: v11.9 — the sweep cannot freeze: pool, verdicts, progress, rotation
changelog: A hung core call leaks one thread, never a pool slot
Inconclusive rows are tracked and retried, not swallowed
A definitive miss settles at once; the fast wall is ~13 s
The bar shows rows in flight; cycle end never clears a live probe
First probe target is the official Cloudflare latency endpoint

downloads.notes: v11.8 — the ladder decides, every target gets its slice
changelog: Every row runs the tested ladder first, then a fresh UrlTest count
All three probe targets are tried inside a 6 second budget
A no-verdict row stays untested instead of red
Still 120 at a time, walk until STOP

downloads.notes: v11.7 — the walk continues: next list, STOP, Cloudflare and Microsoft
changelog: A walked list is replaced by the next 120; working rows stay
STOP stays visible; PING ALL and DELETE ALL stay off while pinging
Probe targets are Cloudflare and Microsoft, with failover

downloads.notes: v11.6 — fast public probes, then a 3-attempt check of the ones that answer
changelog: Public connectivity targets, not one private address
A blocked target does not mark a live config dead
One 4 second probe per row; only the best 20 get 3 attempts
Still 120 configs at a time

downloads.notes: v11.5 — URLTest: three proxy requests, median, stability
changelog: Ping is an HTTPS request through the proxy, not a ping of the server IP
Each config gets 3 fresh attempts; the number is the median
3/3 Available, 1/3 or 2/3 Unstable, 0/3 Unreachable
Still 120 configs at a time

downloads.notes: v11.4 — a real ping moves the row: green to the top, no ping to the bottom
changelog: START SEARCH analyses the link, sets the match, then adds 120 configs
The counter counts finished pings only
A config that pings is pinned to the top
A config that does not ping goes to the bottom

downloads.notes: v11.3 — ping starts with the list, a hung core cannot freeze the sweep
changelog: Configs download first; network analysis no longer blocks the list
The ping starts when the rows appear — the bar leaves 0 as soon as a row is picked up
A hung core call is abandoned after 5 seconds, so one stall cannot freeze the sweep
The probe host is pinned, so the first ping does not wait on device DNS

downloads.notes: v11.2 — a real core ping, not a raw TCP guess
changelog: A raw TCP miss no longer paints a config red — the core always probes
One real core answer is a green ping; a second sample no longer vetoes it
Probe URLs use valid host certificates plus Apple and Firefox fallbacks
The progress bar counts the rows on screen, live

downloads.notes: v11.1 — the ping finally holds: screen-off keep-alive, no gaps, best bank first
changelog: Screen-off network heartbeat (45s) + 3-miss link-lost hint — the sweep survives the locked screen
First-answer fast acquire (3s not 30s) — queued rows carry in seconds instead of stalling
Bank walk ranked by YOUR link's measured health (SourceRanker) — best bank first, not file order
Lossy links probe narrower but longer — no more stall-together-clip-together gaps

downloads.notes: v11.0 — the strongest version: live numbers, full batches, real verdicts
changelog: Connect screen reads the live tunnel flag — numbers show whenever the tunnel is up, no wipes racing the pump
Batches fill before they walk: parallel 4-bank walks per kind, corpus top-up, never below 50 rows
Heartbeat carries the tunnel flag — dashboard splits in-app live from VPN-connected live
Dashboard zero until v11 devices report; honest empty states everywhere

downloads.notes: v10.9 — the sweep that never interferes with itself
changelog: Rotation forgets dropped rows always (no 400-row floor); one sweep at a time with honest buttons
My Configs sinks dead rows to the bottom, pins lowest ping to the top — same rule as Free
Panel: registry-only dashboard (zero until devices report), Users phone columns, real Tracking list
Console 404 + JSON errors fixed; credentials rotated; device facts without identifiers

downloads.notes: v10.8 — stable on second use: re-sync, forget, and stay fast
changelog: Every ping re-syncs the network analysis first — a changed or stale link re-measures before it measures
A rotated list forgets what it dropped: statuses and persisted verdicts go with the dropped rows
Boot analyses the link while the splash is up; the revive re-measures before it rebuilds
Per-device registry: dashboard counts installs and live devices, not counter hits
Users + Tracking pages in the panel (counters only — no IPs, MACs, locations, sites, or apps)
Backup disabled, cleartext disabled, obfuscation on

downloads.notes: v10.7 — fail fast on dead rows, stay generous with live ones
changelog: A dead row ends on its first definitive verdict — no second replay of the same failure
Live-shaped misses keep their retry; the TCP gate answers in ~1.2 s instead of ~4 s
The confirmation trusts the answer it just got instead of paying a third ladder
The sweep walks Server 1 to N in list order; no number and no config repeats
A walked batch rotates to the next one; verdict cache kills duplicate dials
START SEARCH still measures first (Wi-Fi vs SIM, DNS, ports, DPI); manual picks win
An interrupted probe says 'not checked yet — tap PING to retry', never red

downloads.notes: v10.6 — testing that tells the truth, tests every config, and finishes
changelog: No config is skipped without a verdict: endpoint reuse mirrors the measured verdict (or probes the row itself)
Endpoint copies inherit their twin's verdict instead of sitting untested for ever
Pinging… appears only for rows actually being probed
The per-row wall covers the probe-pool queue; a row with no verdict is retried three times
Every failure shows its reason (no TCP answer, invalid config, handshake reset, too slow, …)
The tested config IS the imported config: fields Room cannot store are rebuilt from the raw link
Tapping a config can no longer connect to a different one
Link-aware test tuning per search (Wi-Fi vs cellular, weak, RTT, loss); an explicit pin always wins
Wi-Fi is finally classified as Wi-Fi; a dead row is dialled once instead of twice

downloads.notes: v10.5 — real pings on every row, and a list that keeps moving
changelog: The list advances again: a finished batch is replaced by the next one (Server 1…120 → 121…240, counting up)
Nothing is marked unreachable without a real probe: the port prefilter and the socket wave no longer decide verdicts
The deep-probe cap no longer collapses on a dead-heavy batch (only real pool pressure feeds it)
The 100 KB confirmation is measured from the core's own duration — live nodes on slow links are no longer rejected
A starved probe goes back to untested instead of painting the row unreachable
The ping ladder leads with the DNS-free Cloudflare trace; AUTO never picks a Google endpoint
Bank walk: error-page fetches retried, 30-day reset re-opens every bank, drawn batches are remembered as seen
One universal APK, same signing key as v10.4
Deleting a config from the list now sticks (the delete write used to re-add it)
A slow, partial batch is merged instead of replacing the list

downloads.notes: v10.4 — new config banks, a real ping service, and a sweep that walks in order
changelog: 100 new config banks (50 VLESS + 50 VMESS) replace the old source list
120 configs per batch, from the same bank until it runs out, never repeated
Each search picks the bank by measuring your own connection
Ping service is now a setting: 8 endpoints, each with a live CHECK
CDN mirror chosen automatically (raw is filtered on many links)
The ping bar starts at 0% and the sweep starts from the first config
One universal APK, same signing key as v10.3

downloads.notes: v10.3 — every config shows its verdict, live; pings work again
changelog: The v10.2 regression that made every ping fail is fixed (no mux in the measurement)
Every row shows a live verdict: green pinned on top, red at the bottom
The counter counts the whole batch (no more 0/11 against 36 rows)
A batch is 120 configs: 60 VLESS + 60 VMESS
No more rows stuck on 'Pinging…'; unfinished rows are re-probed
A green config is pinned in the Free list and added to My Configs
One universal APK, same signing key as v10.2

downloads.notes: v10.2 — real search: consecutive numbers, honest verdicts, sources that learn
changelog: Server numbers are consecutive again (no more jumps like 36 → 3456)
A config is never marked dead by a starved or cancelled probe
An unfinished cycle keeps its rows and pings them next
The app learns which source actually works on your network
Source rotation works again; 18 duplicate feeds removed
The per-network strategy really tunes mux, fragmentation and timeouts
A picked mode keeps its own promise (GAMING stays without mux)
One universal APK, same signing key as v10.1

downloads.notes: v10.1 — close means off, use the whole link, announce to the right version
changelog: Closing the app switches the auto-search off; minimising keeps it running
No artificial speed limits — the tunnel uses the whole link
Faster search: dead configs are not probed twice
A green config really connects — it must also carry 100 KB
A dead server is replaced automatically in about 3 minutes
Announcements for the newest version or for older versions, set in the panel
One universal APK, same signing key as v10

downloads.notes: v10 — finish the 240-row batch, pin greens, tunnel IPv4+IPv6
changelog: A 240-row list is walked before the next list is added
My Configs pins a green row the instant it pings
Connected now tunnels IPv4 and IPv6
AUTO uses MASTER so MPTCP cannot look connected while apps stay empty
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.9

downloads.notes: v9.9 — faster real pings; Free list no longer resets between batches
changelog: List / Search ping is a real e2e answer without the 100 KB tax on every row
A later batch is merged; the on-screen snapshot cannot wipe it
Port prefilter no longer shrinks 240 configs down to 18
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.8

downloads.notes: v9.8 — a green ping is a working tunnel; pings survive close; My Configs no longer jumps; caches stay bounded
changelog: List ping and Auto Test use the STANDARD lane (real e2e plus 100 KB payload)
A later session miss no longer wipes a proven ping after close/reopen
My Configs stays still while pinging and sorts once at the end
Free PING ALL keeps its result if you leave the tab
Source and Free-list caches are capped so long sessions stay fast
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.7

downloads.notes: v9.7 — new configs are added and pinged; no duplicate pings; counter matches the real Server name
changelog: Later search cycles no longer drop the configs they just collected
One ping per server identity and per address:port — no duplicate pings
Progress shows Checked n/N and the real Server remark, not a fake index
One fast retry so a real node is not left with no ping
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.6

downloads.notes: v9.6 — faster first working config: small first batch, FIRST_ANSWER discovery, no in-place 15s retry on dead rows
changelog: Search hands ~36 configs to Auto Test instead of waiting for 240
Discovery ping is the fast e2e lane — dead rows are skipped, not retried for 15s
Fresh network profile (ports/DNS/DPI) is reused so Search does not re-measure every time
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.5

downloads.notes: v9.5 — connection-test page no longer freezes at 97%; search hands configs to the ping sweep
changelog: Connection-test page no longer freezes at 97% after applying settings
Auto Test starts only after the first batch is collected, so configs get pinged, pinned, and saved to My Configs
A hung source fetch cannot trap the page — the sweep still starts
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.4

downloads.notes: v9.4 — pings survive minimize, a ping means it connects, disconnect is instant, Reset to default
changelog: Pings survive minimize, tab switch and screen-off — sweeps no longer cancel in the background
A green ping is a real tunnel plus payload, so Connect on that config must work
Live ping stays still through jitter; connecting does not overwrite the list number
Disconnect drops the TUN immediately and no longer freezes on the Xray stop
Watchdog holds a working tunnel while bytes are still moving
Search keeps finding configs with the screen off; new batches merge so greens stay
Reset to default returns every network setting to automatic
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.3

downloads.notes: v9.3 — tunnel survives process kill, unique Server N names, live pin/sink, instant disconnect
changelog: VPN stays up after Android kills the process — user connect intent is persisted and restored
Server names are unique identities (Server 1 is one config, never reused for another)
Working pings pin to the top instantly; failed pings sink to the bottom
PING ALL clears old numbers first, then measures fresh; restart shows the last real ping only
Disconnect closes the tunnel immediately so rapid connect/disconnect does not stick
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.2

downloads.notes: v9.2 — Free list merges instead of resetting, real pings show again, greens pin to the top
changelog: Free list no longer resets: new batches merge in, duplicates (same server or same address:port) are skipped
Pings show again: list/Auto Test use the first-answer path so a working config gets a real millisecond
Configs that ping stay pinned at the top; configs that do not sink to the bottom
The tested X / total N counter resets per batch and never jumps backwards inside a batch
Notification no longer shows ping milliseconds
One universal APK, same signing key as v9.1

downloads.notes: v9.1 — truthful ping: if a config shows a ping it connects; if it will not connect it shows no ping. Rock-solid tunnel.
changelog: A ping is only shown when the config is connectable — no more unstable badge or fake numbers
PING ALL starts at row 1, clears old results first, and measures every row fresh
Ping results survive app restart (Room is the store of record)
Tapping a Free config selects it for Home without leaving the tab
My Configs numbering is 1, 2, 3 on screen; COPY never carries a feed name
STOP goes through one controller; SOCKS/API ports are forced free before every start
Light / Dark / System theme; home banner decodes at the view size
One universal APK for every Android device (7.0+), same signing key as v9.0

downloads.notes: v9.0 — STOP truly stops everything, the disconnect button always obeys, and every working config is visible the instant it proves itself
changelog: STOP now really stops: the background supervisor, the 15-minute WorkManager wake-up, feed fetches and leftover ping jobs are all cancelled the moment you press STOP — nothing keeps running in the background
No more rows stuck at Pinging… after STOP: the list clears instantly and all green configs sort to the top so you can see exactly which ones pinged
A permanent working-configs counter sits above the progress bar — it never disappears while the list has content, on both auto-search and manual ping-all
A config that proves a ping floats to the top immediately, mid-sweep, and stays there through every reload

The disconnect button always obeys: the auto-failover can no longer override your stop and reconnect to another server, a double-tap can no longer turn into an accidental connect, and a lost disconnect is automatically re-sent
Faster, honest sweeps: the same server listed under different names is no longer pinged 3-4 times, and dead configs no longer burn 24 seconds each (now 15s) — the progress line moves visibly faster
Fixed the connect/disconnect cycle leak: an orphaned core that held the VPN ports after rapid cycling (the cause of stops connecting after repeated use) is now cleaned up
One universal APK for every Android device (7.0+), same signing key — installs directly over v8.9

downloads.notes: v8.9 — never degrades, never lies, never drops: week-one slowdown fixed at the root, every ping is fresh and real, verified connections heal themselves
changelog: The week-one slowdown is fixed: diagnostics ledgers, the discovery corpus, orphaned measurement rows and the probe-cap pressure latch are all bounded and released now — the app works the same in week six as in the first hour
Every manual ping is a FRESH real measurement: no more cached values, no more sweep starting mid-list, pings survive closing and reopening the app
The list keeps its order while pinging — rows test in place, then sort once at the end (no more jumping)
A config that pings green in Free is saved to My Configs immediately — no need to leave the tab
Home now always shows the config you picked in Free/My Configs the moment you return
A verified connection heals itself: if the server dies completely, the app switches to the best measured alternative and reconnects through the full proof gate
WiFi roaming and cell handover no longer stall the tunnel (same-type network changes revive it too)
Healthier links now automatically use the streaming-tuned profile (big buffers, long idle) — feeds and video start faster
DNS inside the tunnel has a fallback resolver — one flaky resolver no longer stalls page loads
Port catalogue expanded to 24 ports; the Ports and Fragmentation settings now genuinely affect the engine
Home banner shows the whole image at a proper height; light theme is fully legible (no more invisible button text)
One universal APK for every Android device (7.0+)

downloads.notes: v8.8 — servers are always numbered (never real names, even on copy), WiFi/fixed-line fixed, faster discovery, no infrastructure identity in the app
changelog: Server names are never shown or copied — every config is numbered (Server 1, 2, …) the moment it enters the app, from one counter that never resets
Existing lists upgrade automatically: a one-time background migration renames everything already stored
WiFi / fixed-line internet fixed: no more TCP Fast Open on WiFi auto modes (fixed-line equipment silently dropped it and every handshake died)
Every WiFi network now gets its own measured profile instead of replaying another network's settings for 12 hours
The strategy the engine learns per network now genuinely shapes probing and connecting (it was a dead setting before)

Faster discovery: the adaptive probe controller now actually adapts, probes no longer time out while still waiting in queue, and failed configs cool down 30 minutes instead of being retried every cycle
The app contains no readable reference to its own distribution infrastructure
Home banner art now fills the banner exactly and renders at full sharpness
New ANR watchdog and safe-mode boot on top of the existing crash guards
One universal APK for every Android device (7.0+)

downloads.notes: v8.7 — measurement truth: one real probe engine, database-backed lists at any size, per-network strategy, crash-proof upgrade
changelog: My Configs and Free lists now load through the database with paging — instant at any list size
One measurement engine for lists, auto-test and the connect button: a shown ping is a real, reproducible tunnel measurement
A single failed re-test no longer erases a working config (3 failures in 10 minutes before one is declared dead)
Upgrading with a huge config list no longer crashes — the import is chunked, resumable and backed up
The engine fingerprints your network (measured, never operator names) and learns which method works on it
Overnight auto-test survives process death (WorkManager supervisor) and advances cleanly through consumed sources
Network Settings rebuilt: 11 categorized screens incl. full DNS lab, diagnostics, strategy profiles, export/import
Per-ABI APK splits on the release page for smaller downloads

downloads.notes: v8.6 — disconnect actually stops the tunnel, ping requires proven payload, and the home connect button stays on screen
changelog: Disconnect now tears the VPN session down and cancels the notification
A sticky restart after stop can no longer bring the tunnel back by itself
Connected is only shown after a live device-path check, not a core-only delay
A ping is not shown if the throughput probe failed
The home log no longer grows under the connect button
Exit-IP summaries are printed once per IP/country, not on every resume
